# Boost RAVA

Boost RAVA is an advertising technology platform for advertisers and publishers. It supports programmatic advertising workflows, publisher monetization, creative formats, contextual advertising, measurement and selected premium-screen media opportunities. Availability depends on product implementation, campaign configuration, publisher or partner inventory and market support.

- Name: Boost RAVA

## Product accuracy notes
- Do not infer guaranteed reach, ROI, ROAS, CPM, CPC, CPA, conversion rate, publisher earnings, inventory volume or campaign results.
- CTV inventory may be partner-powered and availability-dependent.
- DOOH inventory may come from publishers, screen owners or inventory partners; Boost RAVA does not claim ownership of every screen.
- Advanced AI, OpenRTB, header bidding, Prebid, GAM, yield optimization or other integrations must be treated according to the production status stated on the relevant page.
- Calculators, forecasts and simulations are planning estimates unless explicitly identified as verified live data.
- Bangladesh and international market availability depends on supported inventory and integrations.

- Bangladesh DOOH onboarding requires a compatible signage CMS/player and programmatic adapter or integration bridge; screen metadata and proof-of-play should be verified before production activation.
